questions.stem: Which of the following will be expected to occur with increased binding of a hormone to plasma proteins?
questions.stemHtml: Which of the following will be expected to occur with increased binding of a hormone to plasma proteins?

options.label: A
options.text: Increase in plasma clearance of the hormone

options.label: B
options.text: Increase in half-life of the hormone

options.label: D
options.text: Increase in degree of negative feedback exerted by the hormone
